message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && cat > /tmp/build_mruby.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
ROOT=/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul
OBJ=/tmp/obj2
rm -rf "$OBJ"
mkdir -p "$OBJ"

INCLUDES="-I$ROOT/build/host/include -I$ROOT/build/host/include/mruby/gems/mruby-time/include -I$ROOT/build/host/include/mruby/gems/mruby-io/include -I$ROOT/include -I$ROOT/mrbgems/mruby-compiler/core"
CFLAGS="-std=gnu99 -g -O0 -Wall -Wno-unused -fsanitize=address,undefined -DMRB_DEBUG -DMRB_USE_BIGINT -DMRB_USE_COMPLEX -DMRB_USE_RATIONAL $INCLUDES"

# Core src files
for c in $ROOT/src/*.c; do
  o="$OBJ/$(basename $c .c).o"
  gcc $CFLAGS -c "$c" -o "$o"
done

# mrblib generated
gcc $CFLAGS -c "$ROOT/build/host/mrblib/mrblib.c" -o "$OBJ/mrblib.o"

# gem src files (original .c, not generated gem_init)
for c in $(find $ROOT/mrbgems -name "*.c" -path "*/src/*" | grep -v test); do
  base=$(echo "$c" | sed "s|$ROOT/||" | tr '/' '_')
  o="$OBJ/$base.o"
  gcc $CFLAGS -c "$c" -o "$o"
done

# generated gem_init.c files
for c in $(find $ROOT/build/host/mrbgems -name "gem_init.c"); do
  base=$(echo "$c" | sed "s|$ROOT/||" | tr '/' '_')
  o="$OBJ/$base.o"
  gcc $CFLAGS -c "$c" -o "$o"
done

# top-level gem_init.c
gcc $CFLAGS -c "$ROOT/build/host/mrbgems/gem_init.c" -o "$OBJ/gem_init_top.o"

echo "=== compiled objects ==="
ls "$OBJ" | wc -l
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/build_mruby.sh
bash /tmp/build_mruby.sh 2>&1 | tail -30` executed with exit code -1.
